top10.descricao_en: Free open-source Windows clipboard manager with searchable history, image previews, tags, editing and backup.
top10.readme:
**Windows Clipboard History Manager is a free, open-source clipboard manager designed to make copying, finding, editing, and reusing information effortless.** Keep a searchable history of copied text, images, files, and links in a modern Windows desktop application without using the command line.
Stop losing important snippets and repeatedly copying the same information. Keep everything organized and accessible from one convenient clipboard history.
## ⬇️ Installation
**Download the Windows application**
1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/Umbra9179/clipboard-history-manager-windows/releases) page.
2. Download the latest release archive **`Windows Clipboard History Manager 4.2.1.zip`**.
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep **`Windows Clipboard History Manager 4.2.1.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder.
5. Double-click **`Windows Clipboard History Manager 4.2.1.exe`** to launch the application.
## ✨ Features
- 📋 **Unlimited Clipboard History** — Automatically maintain an extensive clipboard history so previously copied information remains available when you need it.
- 🔎 **Instant Clipboard Search** — Search through saved clipboard entries and quickly locate text, links, images, and other copied content.
- 🖼️ **Multiple Clipboard Formats** — Preserve formatted text, HTML, rich text, bitmap images, PNG images, and file references.
- ✏️ **Edit Clipboard Entries** — Modify saved text and clipboard content before copying it again or sharing it with another application.
- 🏷️ **Tags and Organization** — Add custom tags and organize clipboard entries into convenient groups for easier retrieval.
- 🪟 **Application Filtering** — Control which source applications contribute clipboard entries and keep unwanted content out of your history.
- 🖱️ **Drag and Drop Support** — Move supported clipboard items directly into compatible desktop applications.
- 📌 **Always-Accessible Window** — Pin the clipboard manager window to keep your saved content accessible while multitasking.
- ☑️ **Multiple Selection** — Select and manage several clipboard entries together for more efficient organization.
- 🔗 **Link and Content Previews** — Recognize useful information at a glance with previews of supported clipboard data.
- 💾 **Clipboard Backup** — Create backups of saved clipboard information to help protect your collected snippets.

# SoduWork
## The AI-native engine for teams and their agents
**A chat ends with an answer. A SoduWork request ends when the person who asked signs off.**
**Multi-harness · Multi-agent · Self-hosted**
Works with Pi · OpenCode · DeepSeek Harness · Qwen Code · Kimi Code · Codex Harness · Codex
**Run from source**
```sh
git clone https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork
cd SoduWork
```
| Platform | Start command |
| --- | --- |
| macOS / Linux | `sh start.sh --desktop` |
| Windows PowerShell | `.\start.cmd --desktop` |
| Windows Command Prompt | `start.cmd --desktop` |
For source setup, we recommend [Python 3.12.x](https://www.python.org/downloads/) and [Node.js 22.x](https://nodejs.org/) (22.19.0 or later in that series). The clone command uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads).
**[Windows desktop app](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases/latest)** | [Website](https://soduwork.ai) | [Live demo](https://soduwork.ai) | [Documentation](docs/README.md) | [Docs website](https://dev.soduwork.ai) | [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)

---
## What SoduWork can do for you
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **One harness does the work, another reviews it** | Pick Pi to do the work. OpenCode, on a different model, reviews it against the acceptance criteria. If the review fails, the work goes back with the reasons. |
| **Hand a request to a colleague's agent** | People and AI work together: you file a request, AI writes the acceptance criteria, and you assign it to yourself or a colleague. The assignee's agent does the work and reviews it, and a person signs off. Everyone on the request can see who did what. |
| **Turn one person's know-how into a team asset** | When you and AI get a task right, save the chat as a plugin. After review, anyone on the team can use it and contribute improvements, with access granted as needed. |
## Core ideas
**🔀 Smart dispatch**
**The right agent and model for each job.**
- Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation
- Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters
- Long tasks go to your own cloud runner
**🛡️ Built-in governance**
**Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.

top10.descricao_en: Free Steam idler for trading card farming, achievement management, playtime boosting and multi-account automation on Windows.
top10.readme:
**Automate your Steam library. Collect cards, manage achievements, and boost playtime with one convenient desktop application.**
Steam Game Idler is a **free, open-source Steam automation tool for Windows** that helps PC gamers automate trading card farming, manage game achievements, and accumulate playtime. Bring essential Steam idling features together in an easy-to-use desktop interface — no command line or scripting required.
Whether you want to collect Steam trading cards, organize achievement management, or leave eligible games idling in the background, Steam Game Idler makes managing your Steam library simpler.
## ⬇️ Installation
**Download the Windows application**
1. Open the repository's [Releases](https://github.com/Basil0879/steam-game-idler/releases) page.
2. Download the latest release archive **`Steam Game Idler 4.0.4.zip`**.
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep **`Steam Game Idler 4.0.4.exe`** and `libvlc.dll` together in that folder.
5. Double-click **`Steam Game Idler 4.0.4.exe`** to launch the application.
## ✨ Features
- 🃏 **Automatic Steam Trading Card Farming** — Automate Steam trading card drops from eligible games in your library and collect cards without manually launching every title.
- 🏆 **Steam Achievement Management** — Manage game achievements through an integrated desktop interface designed for convenient library management.
- ⏱️ **Steam Playtime Boosting** — Let supported games accumulate idle playtime without keeping individual games actively running on your desktop.
- 👥 **Multi-Account Steam Support** — Manage multiple Steam accounts and keep their automation activities organized in one application.
- ⚙️ **Intelligent Game Selection** — Choose which games participate in automation with configurable selection, exclusion, and prioritization options.
- 🔄 **Background Steam Automation** — Keep supported idling tasks running with minimal manual interaction.
- 🖥️ **User-Friendly Windows GUI** — Access Steam idling, card farming, and account management through a straightforward graphical desktop application.
## 🖼️ Overview
Explore the desktop interface and discover how the main Steam automation features fit together.
### All Your Steam Idling Tools in One Place
| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| Trading Card Farming | Automates eligible Steam card drops |
| Achievement Management | Provides achievement-related management tools |
| Playtime Automation | Accumulates idle time in supported games |

top10.descricao_en: 麦田：自媒体多平台发布中控与数据监控（B站/抖音/小红书/视频号/YouTube/X），飞书卡片通知 + 数据大屏
top10.readme:
一行装好  ·
   看它跑一遍  ·
   怎么配合  ·
   各平台的坑  ·
   常见问题  ·
   用户案例  ·
   参与贡献  ·
   作者 
> **一句话**：麦田是 Agent 驱动的自媒体发布工作台——你对 AI 说一句「整理发布」，一期视频填好七个平台，数据每天自己回来。
> **一行装好**：`bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/scripts/install.sh)"`（Windows 见[下文](#一行装好)）· 用麦田做出了东西？[来晒案例](SHOWCASE.md)
一个人做内容，要发六七个平台，每个平台的文案、封面、发布形式都不一样；发完还想知道哪期起来了、哪个平台涨粉、哪个平台真的带来了付费。麦田就是我自己每天在用的那套工作台：
1. **发得出去**：一期视频分批填好 B站、抖音、小红书、视频号、YouTube、X、Instagram，提前排进「分发计划」，到点发布、自动取链接。
2. **看得清楚**：每期在每个平台的播放、互动，各平台粉丝，每天自动采、长期留存；手机上看大屏，飞书群推卡片。
3. **算得出钱**：接上你自己的站点，看哪一期、哪个平台带来了注册和收入。
> 跑在一台常开的 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上，用你自己登录好的浏览器操作各平台，**不存任何平台密码**。国内四家只填写不发布，最后一下由你自己点。
## 看它跑一遍
  一期视频从写文案到上线（47 秒，各平台发布页为示意，数据是作者第 4 期的真实文案和封面）·  高清 MP4   
  大屏（演示数据， node src/demo.mjs  就能看到）  
| 日历：分发计划 | 单期复盘：同龄对比 | 每期转化漏斗 |
|---|---|---|
|   |   |   |
## 怎么配合
| 部分 | 做什么 | 在哪 |
|---|---|---|
| 发布 skill | 让 AI 助手（Claude Code / Codex）看片、写各平台文案、生成发布工程并校验 | 本仓库 [`skills/maitian-publish`](skills/maitian-publish/SKILL.md) |
| 麦田发布助手 | Chrome 插件，各平台适配器：打开上传页、传视频和封面、填文案、设定时 | [Chrome 应用商店](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eaaipbilkhibicihiollecmbpneikpnj)（装进麦田的专用 Chrome，自动更新） |
| 麦田（本仓库） | 分发计划、调度、防重、等你点发布、取链接、采数据、网页大屏、飞书通知 | 本仓库 |
链路：成片 → skill 写「发布素材.md」→ 生成 `publish.json` → `hub plan` 进分发计划 → `hub run` 分批填写 → 国内平台你点发布 → 到点取链接 → 每天采数据 → 大屏和飞书卡片。
## 安装
三种方式，按自己习惯挑一种。
### Agent 自动安装
不动手也能装：把下面这段话复制给你的 AI 助手（Claude Code / Codex 等）。它会读专门的[安装指引](agent-install.md)，自行装好麦田本体，并把发布 skill 装进**它自己**的 skill 目录——各 Agent 的 skill 目录不同，所以让 Agent 按指引自行安装，不依赖一行安装脚本里写死的 Claude 路径：
```text
请帮我接入麦田的发布能力：阅读 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/agent-install.md 并严格按其中的步骤完成安装与授权。
```
### 一行装好
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/scripts/install.sh)"
```
下载麦田和发布助手到 `~/maitian/`、接上发布 skill、打开安装向导；向导问完几个问题，生成配置、装好开机自启、打开各平台登录页。需要 macOS、Node.js ≥ 22.5、Google Chrome。
Windows（社区贡献，感谢 [ajin558](https://github.com/ajin558)）：
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/scripts/install-windows.ps1 | iex"
```
同样下载到 `%USERPROFILE%\maitian\`、接上发布 skill、打开安装向导，安装目录里另有 4 个双击启动器（演示 / 登录 / 体检 / 启动）。需要 Windows 10/11、Node.js ≥ 22.5、Google Chrome。缺 Git 或 Node 时，脚本会用 winget 补装。
在安装向导选「启用 Windows 登录自启，并现在启动麦田」后，麦田会在本次安装结束时启动，以后每次用当前 Windows 账号登录时也会启动。如果大屏端口已有进程监听，安装会跳过本次启动。可以在任务计划程序里找到 `MaitianDaemon-` 开头的任务，查看状态或手动运行。计划任务未运行时，也可以双击安装目录里的 `4-start.bat` 手动启动。
